_comment: Public functions in tools/ that no test mentions, each with the reason
it is allowed to stay that way. This is a ratchet: an entry may be
removed, never added, and a stale entry fails the suite as loudly as a
new gap. It is empty because backlog item 12 emptied it, and the empty
state is the point - the next function that ships without a test fails
the suite instead of waiting for somebody to run an audit.
The answer to a gap is almost always a test that runs the function.
